content.title: WFF | Super Saturday Concert
content.text: Super Saturday Concert presented by AT&T Join us at the FREE Super Saturday Concert presented by AT&T. The event will feature food & drinks for purchase, an opening act and headliner. Quick Navigation: AT&T Fast Lane | Event Information AT&T Fast Lane! Since AT&T is all about speed, we're connecting customers to expedited entry through the AT&T Fast Lane at Super Saturday Concert presented by AT&T. To get in, just show the AT&T icon on your phone screen at the concert entry point. The AT&T Fast Lane allows priority entry for current AT&T customers and (1) guest at Super Saturday Concert presented by AT&T on Saturday, April 4. To take advantage of this expedited entry, fans must arrive at the Main Entry and be able to verify on their phone that AT&T is their wireless provider or have their AT&T Fiber bill ready for verification. Upon arrival, follow signage and staff direction to the AT&T Fast Lane to get your spot at the front of the line. Once doors open, the AT&T Fast Lane will be able to enter the park grounds first!
